name: Iitai Kedo, Iccha Dame
original_name: イイたいけど、イッちゃダメ
source: The protagonist, upon meeting a mysterious girl who did nothing but repeat the same lines, decided to heal her condition by having her feel sexual pleasure.
translation: The protagonist, upon meeting a mysterious girl who did nothing but repeat the same lines, decided to heal her condition by having her feel sexual pleasure.
